player_prompt.intro:
Tqaddec ṭṭawla n waddaden n umḍiq!
Inṭeq: Rmḍu inumiren s +, -, *, / akken ad taweḍḍeḍ ɣer uɣerbaz.
Tasɣent n tigawt: [i j op] anda i,j d ismilen d op d tigawt.
Amedya: [0 2 *] ismḍay inumiren di tasmilt 0 d inumiren di tasmilt 2.
Aɣerbaz s beṭṭu ilaq ad yili d azwil iḥuddan kan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tasɣent n tigawt ur nelli. Seqdec `[i j op]` anda i,j d ismilen d op d +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Iɣil ur nqebbel. Ilaq ad yemgarad d win yellan gar 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Taɣdemt ur nelli ara d tin n tidet (amḍan s uzref neɣ agmuḍ mačči am win imdanen)

outcome.win: D ayen yelhan! Yufa-d iswi n tidet: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Ur llan uɣerwen aṭas. Awakken amezwaru: {best_value} (azerweg: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Taddart n uɣerwen tettwaxṭer. Awakken amezwaru: {best_value} (azerweg: {target})
